routes.title: God, Weep for the Hyakki Empire

rows.en: ...Losing General Hidler was a great shame.
rows.notes: Burai regrets Hidler loss, not an order or apology.

rows.en: Yes... He met a noble end worthy of his rank.
rows.notes: Gura answers Burai; pronoun refers to male General Hidler per glossary.

rows.en: Just as we were about to begin the final operation to conquer the world... What an unlucky fool.
rows.notes: Burai mourns timing; unlucky fool retains contempt.

rows.en: Emperor Burai, please do not lose heart...
rows.notes: Gura respectfully consoles Emperor Burai.

rows.en: All our preparations were completed while General Hidler bought us time.
rows.notes: Context: i083b:4; subject and response restored from surrounding exchange.

rows.en: I'm counting on you, Dr. Gura. The gravity control device you developed is the key to victory.
rows.notes: Burai asks Gura to deliver victory; restored requester direction. Device source-literal.
uncertain: gravity control device is source-literal; licensed English technical label unverified.

rows.en: Yes, sir! Fortress Island is ready to launch at any time.
rows.notes: Context: i083b:6; subject and response restored from surrounding exchange.
uncertain: Source-short Fortress Island is a literal shortened form; licensed English label unverified.

rows.en: Good... I now set the Hyakki Empire's final operation in motion!
rows.notes: Context: i083b:7; subject and response restored from surrounding exchange.

rows.en: Contact Zuril on the Moon! We will bring the full might of the Hyakki Empire to bear against those humans!
rows.notes: Zuril is source-short without title; do not expand to Chief Zuril.

rows.en: Hyakki, Buraaai!
rows.notes: Same allegiance salute as Hidler.
uncertain: Exact established English catchcry spelling unconfirmed.

rows.en: So, what's the Hyakki Empire doing!?
rows.notes: Context: i083b:10; subject and response restored from surrounding exchange.

rows.en: They are deploying attack forces against major cities throughout Japan simultaneously.
rows.notes: Context: i083b:11; subject and response restored from surrounding exchange.

rows.en: We can't sit around here! Let's launch right now!
rows.notes: Context: i083b:12; subject and response restored from surrounding exchange.

rows.en: Calm down, Benkei. Use your head for once.
rows.notes: Context: i083b:13; subject and response restored from surrounding exchange.

rows.en: What do you mean, Hayato?
rows.notes: Context: i083b:14; subject and response restored from surrounding exchange.

rows.en: The enemy's attacks are far too sporadic for an attempt to seize control. Judging by that...
rows.notes: Inference begins here and completes in following row; preserved trailing inference. Source fragment or trailing clause deliberately retained; not unresolved grammatical pro-drop.

rows.en: I believe their objective is some kind of diversion.
rows.notes: Context: i083b:16; subject and response restored from surrounding exchange.

rows.en: A diversion...
rows.notes: Echo of Amuro diversion diagnosis; deliberate noun fragment. Source fragment or trailing clause deliberately retained; not unresolved grammatical pro-drop.

rows.en: They're playing tag with us? Then let's wipe out all those ogres while we're at it.
rows.notes: Ogre/tag wordplay taunts Hyakki; no actual tag game implied.

rows.en: ...You'd better stop underestimating them.
rows.notes: Context: i083b:19; subject and response restored from surrounding exchange.

rows.en: Hayato...
rows.notes: Direct address to Hayato; deliberate fragment. Source fragment or trailing clause deliberately retained; not unresolved grammatical pro-drop.

rows.en: That's not like you, saying something like that.
rows.notes: Light challenges Hayato caution.

rows.en: Are you scared or something?
rows.notes: Context: i083b:22; subject and response restored from surrounding exchange.

rows.en: I'm not scared... But I think I know just how terrifying a decisive battle can be.
rows.notes: Hayato denies fear and distinguishes knowledge of final battles.

rows.en: The Dinosaur Empire and the Mycenae Empire both came at us with everything they had in their final battles...
rows.notes: Hayato recalls both empires launching all-out attacks; following row states their futures were at stake.

rows.en: With their futures at stake.
rows.notes: Continues previous row at matching source boundary: the empires risk their own futures. Source fragment or trailing clause deliberately retained; not unresolved grammatical pro-drop.

rows.en: Their futures...
rows.notes: Hokuto repeats future; deliberate noun fragment. Source fragment or trailing clause deliberately retained; not unresolved grammatical pro-drop.

rows.en: I don't give a damn about the future of a bunch of villains!
rows.notes: Context: i083b:27; subject and response restored from surrounding exchange.

rows.en: ...You're right about that. We can't hand our future over to villains.
rows.notes: Context: i083b:28; subject and response restored from surrounding exchange.

rows.en: But they're desperate, too. They wouldn't attack us expecting to lose from the start.
rows.notes: Context: i083b:29; subject and response restored from surrounding exchange.

rows.en: Knowing that, I can't be as optimistic as you are.
rows.notes: Context: i083b:30; subject and response restored from surrounding exchange.

rows.en: Hayato...
rows.notes: Hokuto quietly addresses Hayato; deliberate fragment. Source fragment or trailing clause deliberately retained; not unresolved grammatical pro-drop.

rows.en: Tch... So you're saying we're a bunch of naive kids...!
rows.notes: Context: i083b:32; subject and response restored from surrounding exchange.

rows.en: H-hey... Cut it out, Kaine.
rows.notes: Context: i083b:33; subject and response restored from surrounding exchange.

rows.en: Then let me ask you, Kaine. Do you have Commander Kunugi's resolve? The resolve to take the enemy down even if it costs your life?
rows.notes: Kunugi resolve invokes prior sacrifice; mutual lethal strike conveyed as victory at cost of own life.

rows.en: W-well, I...
rows.notes: Kaine deliberately trails off after stammer. Source fragment or trailing clause deliberately retained; not unresolved grammatical pro-drop.

rows.en: ...I won't know until the time comes...
rows.notes: Kaine answers after reused Hayato silence at original i083b:36; cannot commit until tested.

rows.en: Remember this. The enemy may be coming at us with that very resolve.
rows.notes: Hayato warns enemy may share Kunugi resolve, does not assert certainty.

rows.en: Listen to you lecturing us...! You're just scared of those ogre bastards!
rows.notes: Context: i083b:39; subject and response restored from surrounding exchange.

rows.en: Heh... If that's what you want to think, go ahead.
rows.notes: Hayato permits Kaine interpretation with dismissive tone.

rows.en: It's the way you say things that pisses me off!
rows.notes: Context: i083b:41; subject and response restored from surrounding exchange.

rows.en: Stop it, Kaine. Hayato has a point, too.
rows.notes: Context: i083b:42; subject and response restored from surrounding exchange.

rows.en: But you're going too far, Hayato. You're oversensitive... or, how do I put it... You think too much.
rows.notes: Benkei hesitates while searching for wording; all criticism retained.

rows.en: ...That's better than being insensitive.
rows.notes: Hayato retorts to Benkei: oversensitivity/overthinking is better than insensitivity; restored context-supported demonstrative subject.

rows.en: What's that supposed to mean!? Are you talking about me!?
rows.notes: Context: i083b:45; subject and response restored from surrounding exchange.

rows.en: Stop it, Benkei! What good will fighting each other here and now do!?
rows.notes: Context: i083b:46; subject and response restored from surrounding exchange.

rows.en: What's wrong with you guys? Falling out with each other at a time like this...
rows.notes: Kirakuni expresses dismay at current falling-out; trailing second phrase deliberate. Source fragment or trailing clause deliberately retained; not unresolved grammatical pro-drop.

rows.en: After what happened to Commander Kunugi of TERRA... I imagine everyone is still in shock.
rows.notes: Amuro attributes tension to shock following Kunugi fate, inferred not certain.

rows.en: I think Ginga and Hokuto are forcing themselves to act cheerful, too...
rows.notes: Eris infers forced cheerfulness rather than asserting inner feelings.

rows.en: I wonder if the Hyakki Empire really is going to launch a decisive attack...
rows.notes: Female lead wonders about decisive attack; no gender assigned to unknown referent.

rows.en: The absolute barrier has vanished, and the MU have appeared. The whole world is in chaos.
rows.notes: MU source abbreviation retained; absolute barrier distinct from AT Field.

rows.en: If they want to seize control of the surface, now would be the perfect time to strike.
rows.notes: Context: i083b:52; subject and response restored from surrounding exchange.

rows.en: So, Amuro... What's being done to intercept the Hyakki Empire?
rows.notes: Context: i083b:53; subject and response restored from surrounding exchange.

rows.en: Dragoon units around the country are handling it.
rows.notes: Context: i083b:54; subject and response restored from surrounding exchange.

rows.en: That said, the attacks are sporadic, and there hasn't been any major damage so far.
rows.notes: Context: i083b:55; subject and response restored from surrounding exchange.

rows.en: So our job is to thwart the enemy's real objective...
rows.notes: Male lead infers own group role; explicit our restored.

rows.en: But sitting around waiting just isn't my style.
rows.notes: Context: i083b:57; subject and response restored from surrounding exchange.

rows.en: I'm with Benkei. Let's storm Ogre Island and settle this once and for all!
rows.notes: Kaine deliberately calls enemy base Ogre Island; correction follows.
uncertain: Ogre Island preserves Japanese folkloric enemy-island wordplay; licensed English wording unverified.

rows.en: It's Fortress Island, not Ogre Island.
rows.notes: Light corrects name while preserving Ogre Island gag.
uncertain: Source-short Fortress Island is a literal shortened form; licensed English label unverified.
Ogre Island preserves Japanese folkloric enemy-island wordplay; licensed English wording unverified.

rows.en: But their base, Fortress Island, can move, so its position is constantly changing...
rows.notes: Base movement established; no flight capability invented in this row.
uncertain: Source-short Fortress Island is a literal shortened form; licensed English label unverified.

rows.en: Of course, the military is searching for Fortress Island, too. Unfortunately, they don't seem to have found it yet.
rows.notes: Military search failure is reported with source uncertainty.
uncertain: Source-short Fortress Island is a literal shortened form; licensed English label unverified.

rows.en: So we're stuck reacting to their moves...
rows.notes: Hayato concludes allies must respond after enemy acts.

rows.en: Ryo, Hayato, Benkei! Fortress Island has appeared!
rows.notes: Michiru addresses Ryo nickname explicitly, not Ryoma full name.
uncertain: Source-short Fortress Island is a literal shortened form; licensed English label unverified.

rows.en: Really, Michiru!?
So where is it!?
Footage is coming in aboard the Nahel Argama. Get up to the bridge right away!
So the Hyakki Empire has finally made its move...!
What is this...!?
rows.notes: Deliberate startled reaction; no invented identification.

rows.en: You can see it on the monitor. According to Far East Command headquarters, at 1300 today...
rows.notes: Briefing sentence deliberately continues in next row; retain time and headquarters.

rows.en: The Fortress Island that appeared in Tokyo Bay began rising into the air from the sea's surface.
Rising into the air!? You mean that ridiculously huge thing is flying!?
And if we work out its destination from the Fortress Island's course...
rows.notes: Sentence deliberately hands destination to Michiru in next row.

rows.en: The Saotome Institute...!
rows.notes: Destination response fragment retained.

rows.en: Yes. It seems the Hyakki Empire intends to strike the Saotome Institute while its diversion distracts defense units across the country.
I believe the Hyakki Empire intends to use the institute as a foothold to conquer Japan.
The Saotome Institute is in central Japan and has an inexhaustible energy source, the Getter Ray amplifier...
rows.notes: Sentence continues into the forward-base judgment in next row; inexhaustible energy, amplifier and central Japan retained.

rows.en: It certainly is ideal for a forward base.
Let's go, Ryo, Benkei! Even if it's just us, we'll go on ahead and hold them off!
rows.notes: Source nickname Ryo; team volunteers to go ahead alone, not entire fleet.

rows.en: That's reckless! Taking on the Hyakki Empire's all-out attack with just one Getter Robo!
rows.notes: Outcry retains the source fragment after the complete initial judgment.

rows.en: But only Getter Liger has the speed to catch up with them.
That's true, but...
rows.notes: Deliberately unfinished concession retained.

rows.en: ...Will you go for us?
rows.notes: Bright asks the Getter Team to undertake the mission; request direction preserved.

rows.en: Of course! To crush the Hyakki Empire's ambitions...
rows.notes: Purpose phrase deliberately continues across the row boundary.

rows.en: And to protect the Saotome Institute, our home!
rows.notes: Completes previous purpose phrase; institute is also their home.
Silence retained.

rows.en: Don't worry, Michiru. We'll protect the institute.
Hayato... But... But you...
rows.notes: Michiru cannot complete her fear for the team; no death prediction added.

rows.en: Michiru, hold on to this for me...
rows.notes: Hayato asks Michiru to keep his cross, not offers to keep hers.

rows.en: This... Isn't this the cross you always wear, Hayato...?
rows.notes: Cross identified by Michiru; Hayato is its wearer.

rows.en: ...The chain broke. Fix it for me.
rows.notes: Chain is the broken object; request direction preserved.

rows.en: Hayato...
rows.notes: Name-only emotional address retained.

rows.en: I promise... I'll come back alive, no matter what... So, I'm off.
Yes...
All right... Getter Team, launch!
Me! Number one in the Commander Ranking! Beaten?!
uncertain: Source is a defeat cry with no verb ('This me, No. 1 in the Commander Ranking...!'); 'Beaten?!' supplied from the context of a defeat line. 'Commander Ranking' from glossary term [jp].

rows.en: Nuuuoooh! Me... How could I, of all people...?!
uncertain: Source is a bare 'Me... this me?!' defeat cry; 'How could I' supplies the implied disbelief.

rows.en: Rom!!
Mark my words! I shall return!
uncertain: [jp] is English in katakana; rendered as plain English.

rows.en: Lord Gades, I served you faithfully! Why won't you come to save me?!
uncertain: ガデス様 rendered 'Lord Gades'; assumed the line is addressed to Gades (rescue plea).

rows.en: Ah, no! My Commander Ranking's gonna drop!
uncertain: Kansai-dialect comic line ('[jp]'); dialect conveyed only through casual register.

rows.en: Milady! Master Rom! I am terribly sorry!
uncertain: お嬢様 = Leina (Jim is Leina's servant) -> 'Milady'; ロム様 -> 'Master Rom'.

rows.en: What has justice ever done for me? Justice does nothing for anyone...
uncertain: くれる object not stated; 'for me' / 'for anyone' chosen.

rows.en: Pass this on! Tell them I fought a battle no martial artist would be ashamed of!
uncertain: 伝えてくれ has no stated recipient; kept unnamed ('Tell them'). Likely meant for Rom, not asserted.

rows.en: Brother Rom! I'm sorry!
Wh-wh-whoa! Rooom~!
I'm counting on you to carry on!
uncertain: 後を頼む: Rom asks the listener (his allies) to take over; listener not named.

rows.en: Unable to continue combat...
They got me?! No way!!
uncertain: やられた has no subject; 'They got me' (agent unspecified).

rows.en: Ah... Aaah?!
N-no way... Is this as far as I go...?!
Y-you're kidding! Me, of all people?! I can't believe it!
Ugh! I can't be like this... I just can't let it end like this!
uncertain: [jp]: the 'I' is inferred (Asuka berating herself).

rows.en: Yes... That's how it should be......

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled from glossary ＥＶＡ量産機 = 'Mass-produced EVA'.

rows.en: I'll leave your fate be... for now!
uncertain: [jp] (retreat line): 'I'll hold off on your fate for a while'.

rows.en: Careless of me... Is this the end...?!
Damn, is this as far as I go?!
No...! It can't be, not this!!

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; ガルファ speaker filled as 'Gulfer' (glossary term ガルファ, do_not_touch). Probably the generic Gulfer soldier unit (ガルファ素体 = 'Gulfer Soldier'); kept the shorter in-game label.

rows.en: O-Oyakata-samaaa!
uncertain: お館様 kept as 'Oyakata-sama' per glossary term.

rows.en: Wh-what?! Impossible!!
Th-this can't... This is absurd...!!
It's no good! I have to bail out!
uncertain: 脱出しないと has no subject; 'I' inferred (Kirakuni flies the Cell Fighter; not verified that it is solo).

rows.en: We have to... bail out...!
uncertain: 脱出しなきゃ has no subject; 'We' inferred because Dendoh is co-piloted by Ginga and Hokuto. This line is reused in 3 places (s00r00:32/33/173) and may play when Hokuto is in another unit - check.

rows.en: Is this the end...?!
Nuooooooh!!
It seems retreat is my only choice...!
uncertain: [jp]: subject inferred as 'my' (Vega speaking for herself); could be 'our' if she leads a group.

rows.en: Your Majesty, Gulfer Emperor... Please... forgive me...
uncertain: [jp] -> 'Your Majesty, Gulfer Emperor' using glossary 'Gulfer Emperor' (note: glossary en_short for that entry is 'Galfa Emperor', inconsistent with en_full/do_not_touch 'Gulfer').

rows.en: B-bailing out~! Ryoko, don't get mad at me, okay?!
uncertain: 脱出 has no subject; rendered as 'bailing out' (Hikaru herself).

rows.en: Curses...! Hurry, all hands, evacuate!
Dammit! Is this how it ends?!
Wha! This is as far as I go?! How pathetic...!
uncertain: ここまでかよ / 情けねえ: subject 'I' inferred (Saburota about himself).

rows.en: Yu... Yurika......
In death, none shall gather my bones... To perish is my fate...
uncertain: [jp] is a stock oath phrase ('none will gather the corpse of the fallen'); rendered with 'my' since he is speaking of himself.

rows.en: Omoikane... I'm sorry. All hands, abandon ship!
This is the end... and that's a wrap...
uncertain: 一巻の終わり ('end of the scroll' = 'it's all over'); Izumi is a punster, 'that's a wrap' keeps the media idiom.

rows.en: Ngh! Next time, victory will be ours!
Uwaah! Captain, sir!!
uncertain: 大尉殿 = Meio (captain) -> 'Captain, sir'.

rows.en: Dammit, you'll pay for this! You Dragonar scum!!
uncertain: 覚えていろ rendered 'you'll pay for this' (stock threat).

rows.en: Uoooooh?!
D-dammiiiit!!
Take care of my mom for me...!!
uncertain: 頼んだぜ: Kaine asks the listener (unnamed) to look after his mother; direction kept as a request.

rows.en: C-Colonel!!
uncertain: 大佐 = Gon Jem (colonel).

rows.en: What?! Waaaah!!
It's no good! I'm bailing out!!
C-Captain, sirrr!
uncertain: 大尉殿 = Meio.

rows.en: As long as I live, the Giganos Empire shall never fall...!
uncertain: [jp] literally 'as long as I am here'; 'as long as I live' chosen.

rows.en: Heh, so this is as far as I go...
Tch, that's all for today!
uncertain: ここまで: impersonal 'that's all for today' kept (Min retreating).

rows.en: Sorry! This is as far as I go!
Am I going down...?!
Ngh, how could this...
uncertain: なんという… trails off in the source; kept the omission.

rows.en: Ah, no...!
Waaaah!! I-it's no good~
Judau! They got me!
No no no no!
Dammit! Sorry, I'm bailing out!
D-damn! They got me!
This is... the end...
N-no good! I've been hit!
Big brother...!
uncertain: Leina's brother is Judau; kept as 'Big brother' rather than naming him, matching the source.

rows.en: Aah, why did this happen to me of all people!?
uncertain: Source is the fragment 'why this me!?' (nande kono atashi ga); restored a verb ('happen to me').

rows.en: No good! I'm bailing out!
My unit's already done for!? Amuro...!
uncertain: Source 'mou kitai ga!?' omits the predicate; inferred 'already done for' (unit destroyed).

rows.en: So this is it... All hands, evacuate!
I... I lost...!
uncertain: Source 'maketa no ka' has no subject; restored 'I' (Argo about himself).

rows.en: Ugh! D-Domon!!
Hahaha... It's no use! You have no chance of winning...
You lot are finished no matter whaaat!
Splendid... Gwaaah!!
Ugh... ugh... I... I lost...!
uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled 'Sai Saici' from glossary (speaker_jp is the short form 'Saishi').

rows.en: Ugh, guh, ah, aaaagh!
Alas... My fate, too, ends here...
Jeeesus! You gotta be kidding me!
Graaaaaah!!
Brrrrrr...
uncertain: Horse noise (Fuunsaiki); kept as 'Brrrrrr...'.

rows.en: Waaaaagh!
D-Domooon!!
You'd better remember this, you bastard!
Wh-whoa-whoaaa~
uncertain: Boss's comic exclamation 'arryaryaaan' has no fixed English; rendered as a goofy 'Wh-whoa-whoaaa~'.

rows.en: Noooo~! Koji~!
Daaamn iiit!
I'm bailing out!
Oh, come on. Whoa!?
Oh well. I'm counting on you for the rest, everyone.
uncertain: Direction: 'ato wa tanomu ze, minna' = Hayato asking everyone to handle the rest.

rows.en: Kyaaaah! Ryo! Hayato! Benkei!
rows.notes: Source nickname maps to Ryo per campaign_terms.json and https://srw.wiki.cre.jp/wiki/流竜馬; full 竜馬 remains Ryoma.
uncertain: Source says 'Ryou-kun' (nickname for Ryoma). No glossary entry for the nickname; used glossary short name 'Ryoma'. Could be 'Ryo' if the project prefers nicknames. Honorific -kun dropped.

rows.en: Don't think this means you've won!
E-Emperor Burai!
Getter's power is... Dammit!
uncertain: Kept the source's cut-off: 'Getter's power is...' (predicate omitted in JP, deliberately unfinished).

rows.en: J-Juniooor~!
uncertain: Zuril cries out 'Junior'; glossary has the unit 'Zuril Jr.'. Referent inferred to be his Zuril Jr.; kept as 'Junior' since that is what he shouts.

rows.en: King Vegaaaa!
uncertain: 'Vega Daiou-sama': honorific -sama not rendered separately; 'King' carries it.

rows.en: I am the king of the universe, King Vegaaa!
Kyaaaah! Kojiii!!
Kyaaaah!
Damn, I got careless! Me, of all people!
U-urgh... Jigajiga... Is this as far as we go...!
uncertain: 'Jigajiga' = his Vega Beast (glossary: Vega Beast Jigajiga). Restored subject 'we' (Mors + Jigajiga).

rows.en: I'm counting on you all to protect the Earth!
uncertain: Direction: Duke asking the others (kimitachi de) to protect Earth.

rows.en: Kyaaah!! Daisuke!
uncertain: Honorific -san dropped.

rows.en: Ooooh! Ugwaaaaaagh~!
I'm sorry... Miku...
Nuooooooh!!
No way! Zeorymer is going down!?
uncertain: Source 'masaka, Zeorymer ga!?' omits the predicate; inferred 'is going down' (unit-destroyed line).

rows.en: No way! Zeorymer is going down!?
uncertain: Same line as 363 (Masaki instead of Masato); same inferred predicate.

rows.en: Impossible...! Omzack... my "Lightning"!
uncertain: Glossary unit is 'Omzack of the Lightning' (character entry for Saiga says 'Thunder'); used 'Lightning' to match the unit name.

rows.en: Tau... I'm sorry... I... you...!
uncertain: speaker_en empty; filled 'Shi-Aen' from glossary (speaker_jp is short 'Aen'; glossary only has the full form). Kept source omission 'watashi wa... anata wo...!' (no verb); the intended verb is not settled out of context. 'Tau' used bare as in source; glossary full name Shi-Tau.

rows.en: Big sister...
uncertain: speaker_en empty; filled 'Shi-Tau' from glossary (speaker_jp is short 'Tau').

rows.en: Y-Yuratei...
...I was careless... I... have lost...
Saiga... I... end here...
uncertain: Source 'watashi wa... koko de...' omits the verb; inferred 'end here' (dying/defeat).

rows.en: Damn... A lifelong disgrace for Kyoshiro Yuzuki!
Damn!! It's no good!
Ugh! I've been hit!?
Kyaaaah!!
Not yet! Raideen! Whoa!
This... can't be...!
Damn, it's no good!!
Waaaaaah!!
Eek!! No...!! It can't be!!
Ah! Is this the end!?
Kyaaah!!
Graaaaaah!!
Kyaaah!!
Waaaaaah!!

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled 'Sai Saici' from glossary.

rows.en: Graaaaaah!!
Kyaaah!!
Uwaaagh!
uncertain: JP raw line lacks the closing bracket; translated the body only.

rows.en: 1. Destroy all enemies.
rows.notes: Player; victory objective; no dialogue referent. Decision: Restore settled subjects/actions in natural spoken English; preserve tone and row boundary.

rows.en: 1. Any allied unit is shot down.
rows.notes: Listener: player. Loss condition, plain text; preserves one line and the any-one-allied-unit trigger.

rows.en: Th-this is Red Arrow Squadron! R-reinforcements... Requesting reinforcements!!
rows.notes: Distress call, Red Arrow unit introduces itself; stutters retained.
uncertain: Red Arrow Squadron is source-literal. Root checked Akurasu/primary sources with no exact licensed formation wording found; no RAF identity, aircraft or formation size inferred.

rows.en: S-something that huge can fly...!
rows.notes: Startled fragment retained without invented cause.

rows.en: B-but if we retreat here, Japan will...!!
rows.notes: Deliberately unfinished warning about Japan retained.

rows.en: Heh heh heh, you humans... It's laughable to think you can stop us with such puny forces.
Dr. Gura, crush anyone who obstructs Hyakki Fortress Island's advance.
rows.notes: Canonical Hyakki Fortress Island; Gura addressed by source short name with protected Dr. Gura spelling required in final.
uncertain: Canonical Hyakki Fortress Island has no independently sourced exact English label in main glossary.

rows.en: Yes, sir! Fortress Island, open fire!
U-uwaaaah!!
Oh no! The Dragoon squadron...!
rows.notes: Alarm deliberately breaks after Dragoon unit; no unspoken casualty count.

rows.en: Hmph. The humans' new weapons are surprisingly fragile.
Naturally. This Fortress Island embodies the very best of the Hyakki Empire's science...
rows.notes: Gura praises fortress science; trailing description retained.

rows.en: Now that our newly developed gravity control device enables it to fly, it is truly invincible.
rows.notes: New gravity control device enables flight; no added field capability.
uncertain: gravity control device is source-literal; root found Japanese SRW Wiki corroboration of compound, but exact licensed English remains unverified.

rows.en: Excellent work, Dr. Gura... Now we can avenge Hidler, who fell in battle.
rows.notes: Hidler has fallen; avenge captures redressing his unfulfilled regret, without adding killer identity.

rows.en: Yes... We owe our advance this far entirely to the General.
rows.notes: General refers back to deceased Hidler, not present Emperor Burai.

rows.en: ...By the way, what about the reinforcements from Skull Moon?
Well... We've had no response at all from Zuril.
Then forget them. I never trusted those aliens to begin with...
If they intend to betray us, we can crush them after we crush the humans.
Yes, Your Majesty!
rows.notes: Formal assent to sovereign, not laughter.

rows.en: Good... Crush the Saotome Institute and build our forward base on this land. Begin the all-out attack at once.
Stop, you demons!!
rows.notes: Hidden speaker stays ??? despite following Getter Team reveal.

rows.en: Oh, the Getter Team!
Oh... You came with just one machine?
It appears they've come ahead of #部隊名's main force.
So you've come to hold us off. Amusing... You're truly like summer insects flying into the fire.
rows.notes: Source summer-insects/fire metaphor retained, not literal insect species.
uncertain: Summer insects flying into fire is a literal version of the source self-destruction idiom; exact licensed line unverified.

rows.en: Hyakki robots, launch! Make a bloodbath of Getter!!
rows.notes: Bloodbath threat retains source violence.

rows.en: Damn it, we're up against that ridiculously huge fortress and Hyakki robots!!
Listen, Hayato, Benkei! We'll defend the institute until everyone else arrives!!
Roger!
Michiru... I'll protect the institute and the doctor. Even if it costs me my life...!
rows.notes: Thought vow contrasts with earlier assurance of coming back alive; no smoothing of contradiction.

rows.en: E-Emperor Burai! We can't hold out any longer!
I-impossible! I, the ruler of the world, defeated by humans...!!
rows.notes: Burai trails off while rejecting defeat; fragment retained.

rows.en: That must... That must never be allowed to happen! Never... Nwoooooooh!!
Emperor Burai! I'll show you the power of the Getter Rays you wanted so badly!
rows.notes: Conditional Ryoma encounter with final Combined Hyakki Robot; not consecutive main-event dialogue. Getter Rays exact glossary.

rows.en: You impudent fool! No matter how mighty that power is, it's no match for this Combined Hyakki Robot!
rows.notes: Source abbreviated unit label resolves to Akurasu Combined Hyakki Robot.

rows.en: Then we'll pit our power against yours head-on! Let's settle this, Emperor Burai!
You should have died! I'll personally send you to your grave!
rows.notes: Conditional Hayato encounter after survival reveal; insult retains claim he should already be dead.

rows.en: I swore to someone dear to me that I'd come back alive...!
rows.notes: Dear person is Michiru, established by i083b:88..93 promise; keep unnamed as in source.

rows.en: I can't let a villain like you take my life!
Here I come, Emperor Burai! No matter who we're up against, Poseidon won't lose when it comes to power!
rows.notes: Poseidon source-short, not expanded to Getter Poseidon.

rows.en: I won't let you! I rule the Hyakki Empire! That means I rule this world!
rows.notes: Independent Benkei encounter reply; Burai equates empire rule with world rule.

rows.en: You can't get away with that selfish logic! I'll break those horns you're so proud of!
Prepare yourself, Emperor Burai! I'll pay you back for attacking the institute on my father's behalf!
rows.notes: Michiru avenges attack on institute on her father Dr. Saotome's behalf.

rows.en: You little girl! I, Burai, haven't sunk so low that the likes of you can defeat me!
You've got some guts, coming out to fight in person at the very end!!
rows.notes: Independent Koji encounter; at the very end retains final personal sortie timing.

rows.en: Shut up, boy! Now that I'm here, don't think you'll get out alive!
Prepare yourself, Emperor Burai! Your defeat was sealed the moment you left your lair!
Keep babbling! After I crush you, I'll resume the invasion with Fortress Island!
rows.notes: Fortress Island source-short capitalized; retain his intent to resume invasion despite current sabotage.
uncertain: Fortress Island is canonical source-short literal base label; exact licensed English label unverified.

rows.en: You're pitiful, Emperor Burai! In the end, there can be no trust between evildoers!
rows.notes: Independent Duke encounter references s0830:438..449 Zuril betrayal, not earlier promises of support.

rows.en: Silence! I'll deal with those traitors from Planet Vega after I've dealt with you!
rows.notes: Planet Vega retained; traitors are Vegan allies, not Duke or the player force.

rows.en: Fortress Island has stopped functioning because of you! You won't get away with this!
uncertain: Fortress Island is canonical source-short literal base label; exact licensed English label unverified.

rows.en: Even a mighty dam can collapse from a single ant's hole! Your defeat was sealed when you grew overconfident in your fortress's power!!
rows.notes: Literal ant-hole/dam metaphor retained; refers to Domon/Hayato/Rom sabotage.
uncertain: Ant-hole/dam proverb rendered literally; exact licensed line unverified.

rows.en: Your resolve to risk your life in this attack is impressive...! But evil will never win!
rows.notes: Independent Rom encounter; admires suicidal resolve while rejecting evil victory.

rows.en: Justice and evil are irrelevant! Whoever has power wins and takes everything! And that can only be me!
Getter Robo, you certainly put up a good fight. But can you stop this...?
rows.notes: Main interception event begins here after conditional encounter storage; Getter initially fights alone.

rows.en: Damn it, there are so many of them!!
Those bastards mean to settle this right here...!
Getter Team, return to base! You have no chance against that many enemies!
rows.notes: Saotome orders Getter Team to return, not asks for reinforcements.

rows.en: B-but then they'll destroy the institute!!
Ryo, now we've got no choice but to break through at a single point!!
rows.notes: Source nickname Ryo; focused breakthrough attack rather than scattering or retreat.

rows.en: Yeah, we have just one target...! Fortress Island's core!!
rows.notes: Target is Fortress Island core; no invented control-room identity.
uncertain: Fortress Island is canonical source-short literal base label; exact licensed English label unverified.

rows.en: Here we come, Hyakki Empire!
Hayato, Benkei! Time your pedal presses together!!
rows.notes: Three pilots coordinate pedal timing for Getter Shine/Shine Spark.

rows.en: Right!!
Yeah!!
Uooooh! Getteeeeer Shiiiiine!!
rows.notes: Elongated Getter Shine activation call is distinct from following Shine Spark.
uncertain: Getter Shine is canonical project literal activation call; no exact licensed English attack-call wording verified.

rows.en: Hmph, I won't let you fire your Shine Spark!
Concentrate your fire! Keep Getter Robo away from Fortress Island!
uncertain: Fortress Island is canonical source-short literal base label; exact licensed English label unverified.

rows.en: Ugh, uwaaah!!
rows.notes: Pained cry after concentrated fortress fire.

rows.en: Hayato!!
H-hey, Hayato!? Answer me, Hayato! Hayato!!
rows.notes: Benkei demands a reply from Hayato; repeated calls retained.

rows.en: Benkei, check the monitor!
rows.notes: Ryoma tells Benkei to inspect via monitor; no inference he must inspect Hayato physically.

rows.en: R-Ryo! Hayato isn't in the cockpit!!
Wh-what...!?
rows.notes: Deliberate shocked incomplete reaction retained.

rows.en: Ryo, what's happened!? Give me a situation report!!
L-Liger's cockpit...!!
rows.notes: Deliberate incomplete cockpit report; no invented damage description.
Punctuation-only surprise retained.

rows.en: H-Hayato... He was thrown outside...!!
rows.notes: Hayato is thrown out of cockpit; report trails off. Later survival does not soften initial alarm.

rows.en: Wh-what did you say!?
Heh heh heh, now Getter is...
rows.notes: Burai deliberately leaves Getter's fate unstated at approaching-object interruption.

rows.en: Emperor Burai, we've detected an object approaching us!

rows.notes: Punctuation-only surprise retained.

rows.en: Ryo! Are you all right!?
rows.notes: Source nickname Ryo, Koji addresses Ryoma arriving with reinforcements.

rows.en: E-everyone...!!
rows.notes: Deliberate emotional address fragment on seeing allies retained.

rows.en: All units, launch immediately!
Heh heh heh... You're a moment too late, #部隊名.
rows.notes: Reused gap s0830:291 Bright sortie order examined; team placeholder preserved with runtime width.

rows.en: Emperor Burai...! So the Hyakki Empire's boss has finally come out!
Ryoma, report your status! Is Getter all right!?
rows.notes: Source full short given name Ryoma, not nickname Ryo.

rows.en: Hayato... Hayato is...!
rows.notes: Ryoma cannot finish reporting Hayato's fate; no explicit death assertion added.

rows.en: What happened to Hayato!?
Hayato...! Hayato's been taken down...!
rows.notes: Source euphemism for apparent loss retained as taken down; later rescue confirms no literal death.
Punctuation-only shock retained.

rows.en: N-no... Hayato!?
rows.notes: Duke's shocked name-only question retained, not rewritten into invented confirmation of death.

rows.en: It's a lie...! It's a lie! I can't believe it!!
But it's true. Getter fell before me...
rows.notes: Burai asserts Getter defeat despite later recovery; no death claim added.

rows.en: If you can't believe it, try calling Hayato Jin's name. Of course, there's no chance he'll answer.
rows.notes: Full Hayato Jin used because source explicitly uses family+given name; taunt says no reply.

rows.en: Th-that bastard...!!
rows.notes: Koji reacts angrily to Burai mocking the presumed death; source stutter retained.

rows.en: U-ugh... Hayato...!
rows.notes: Ryoma is overcome by grief; nonverbal groan and name only, deliberate fragment.

rows.en: Ryo, pull yourself together! The battle is still going on!
rows.notes: Duke urges Ryoma to regain composure during battle; source nickname Ryo preserved.

rows.en: I... We've lost Hayato too, after losing Musashi...!
rows.notes: I to we self-correction retained; Hayato is the second presumed loss after Musashi.

rows.en: I'll never forgive you... Never, Hyakki Empire!
rows.notes: Benkei addresses the Hyakki Empire collectively, personal subject restored.

rows.en: Hmph. What can Getter do in that state? I'll soon send you after him as well.
rows.notes: Burai threatens Ryoma and Benkei with the same fate as Hayato; him is Hayato.

rows.en: Damn...! We'll avenge Hayato ourselves!!
rows.notes: Ryoma insists he and Benkei will avenge Hayato themselves.

rows.en: Wait, both of you! Return to the institute at once!!
rows.notes: Saotome orders both remaining Getter pilots to return immediately; institute is source-short.

rows.en: I can't obey that order!!
rows.notes: Ryoma refuses Saotome order, polite source rendered as direct refusal.

rows.en: We'll take them down even if we have to die with them!!
rows.notes: Benkei promises mutual destruction if necessary; no softening of suicidal resolve.

rows.en: You fools!! Do you think doing that would make Hayato happy!?
rows.notes: Saotome rebukes both pilots, rhetorical question retains Hayato happiness.
Wordless recoil from reprimand; deliberate interjection.

rows.en: Ryo, Dr. Saotome is right. Leave this to us!
rows.notes: Kazuya tells Ryo to leave the battle to the allies; restored subject and direction.

rows.en: We'll avenge Hayato, I swear! So... So, please...!
rows.notes: Ginga promises revenge and breaks off while pleading; please expresses unfinished appeal, not an added order.

rows.en: So, Ryo...! Please retreat for now...!
rows.notes: Michiru completes the appeal to Ryo: retreat temporarily.

rows.en: ...A-all right...! Getter Robo is falling back...!
rows.notes: Ryoma accepts, then announces Getter Robo withdrawal; stutter and strained trailing end retained.

rows.en: Heh heh heh, Getter Robo. You've run home with your tail between your legs.
rows.notes: Burai mocks Getter withdrawal with tail-between-legs idiom.

rows.en: Shut up! Don't forget you've still got us to deal with!!
rows.notes: Akira challenges Burai on behalf of remaining allies.

rows.en: We'll make you pay for the anger and sorrow of losing our friend!!
rows.notes: Domon turns grief and anger at losing their friend back on the enemy.

rows.en: Such beautiful friendship. But soon you'll meet Hayato Jin in hell...
rows.notes: Burai threatens reunion in hell; explicit full Hayato Jin retained.

rows.en: Dr. Gura, bring out our little surprise.
rows.notes: Burai tells Gura to deploy the prepared asset; surprise keeps example-item ambiguity before reveal.

rows.en: Yes, sir!
rows.notes: Formal affirmative to Burai in both uses: deployment s0830:324 and fortress ram order s0830:391.

rows.en: D-Dragonsaurus!?
rows.notes: Shinji recognizes Dragonsaurus; canonical unit spelling and stutter.

rows.en: But we were supposed to have defeated it during the Sumonada Sea operation...!
rows.notes: Masato recalls supposed defeat at Sumonada Sea; assertion of prior defeat with apparent contradiction.

rows.en: It's probably one of those cases where they brought back some cells and did something or other with biotechnology...
rows.notes: Saburota guesses recovered cells and biotechnology, deliberately vague something-or-other retained.

rows.en: So, in other words, it's what you'd call a clone.
rows.notes: Hikaru concludes the monster is a clone.

rows.en: ...They must have groaned over making that clone...
rows.notes: Coordinator localized clone/groan rhyme for natural English, retaining the clone-making difficulty joke. Figurative groaning is a wordplay adaptation, not an added literal event.
uncertain: Clone/groan adaptation preserves clone-making difficulty; original Japanese soundplay and exact licensed line remain unverified.

rows.en: You idiot! This is no time for your lousy jokes!!
rows.notes: Ryoko sharply insults Izumi for joking during the crisis.

rows.en: Then we'll just have to wipe out the demons and the octopus together...!
rows.notes: Asuka calls the Hyakki demons and Dragonsaurus an octopus; both enemies retained.

rows.en: Yeah! We'll avenge Hayato! I'll knock that flying Ogre Island out of the sky with Dragonar!!
rows.notes: Kaine vows revenge with Dragonar; literal flying Ogre Island folklore joke, no named location expansion.

rows.en: All units, begin your attack! We settle things with the Hyakki Empire here!
rows.notes: Misato commands all units to attack and settle conflict with the Hyakki Empire here.

rows.en: 1. Allied mothership is shot down.
rows.notes: Player; defeat objective; allied carrier condition. Decision: Restore settled subjects/actions in natural spoken English; preserve tone and row boundary.

rows.en: Hmph. With that many of them together, they certainly are a nuisance...
rows.notes: Burai finds the gathered allies troublesome; quantity and nuisance both retained.

rows.en: Dr. Gura, show them the power of our Fortress Island.
rows.notes: Burai commands Gura to demonstrate Fortress Island power; source-short capitalization.
uncertain: Fortress Island exact shortened licensed English wording remains unverified; source-literal established central term.

rows.en: Understood. All guns, prepare to fire a full salvo! Target the enemy carriers!
rows.notes: Gura gives salvo orders to all batteries against allied motherships.

rows.en: U-ugh, direct hit to starboard! We're losing altitude!!
rows.notes: Torres reports direct starboard hit and ship sinking in flight; altitude interpretation from flying fortress/ships.

rows.en: Hold out, whatever it takes!!
rows.notes: Bright urges crew to keep holding out; implied crew subject is imperative.

rows.en: W-what was that...!?
rows.notes: Misato reacts to unexpected shellfire; stutter retained.

rows.en: It was shellfire from the enemy fortress!
rows.notes: Linda identifies enemy fortress as firing source.

rows.en: They're targeting us directly! Torres, return fire with the Mega Particle Cannon!!
rows.notes: Bright notes direct targeting and orders Torres to retaliate with canonical Mega Particle Cannon.

rows.en: Roger!
rows.notes: Torres acknowledges.

rows.en: Heh heh heh, how futile.
rows.notes: Gura derides retaliation as futile.

rows.en: It's no use, Captain! We can't damage the enemy fortress!
rows.notes: Torres reports inability to damage fortress to Captain Bright; source Captain, no Colonel.

rows.en: What!?
rows.notes: Exclamation; deliberate interjection fragment.

rows.en: Could it be like that Mecha Yousaiki we fought before...!?
rows.notes: Michiru compares protection to past Mecha Yousaiki; trailing comparison retained as unfinished question.

rows.en: Is it covered in a special field, like the first Pikadron!?
rows.notes: Tetsuya compares special field to first Pikadron; source-short name only, no full unit epithet.

rows.en: So what!? When it comes to barriers and fields...
rows.notes: Koji dismisses danger and begins his barriers assertion; deliberate trailing fragment completed by Asuka next row.

rows.en: You're going to say we should just smash through it!? Have you even thought about how huge that thing is!?
rows.notes: Asuka interrupts with Koji proposed brute-force solution and reminds him of fortress size.

rows.en: ! O-oh, right...
rows.notes: Koji realizes the scale problem; surprise punctuation and stutter.

rows.en: With something that enormous, breaking through part of the field won't have much effect...!
rows.notes: Miku explains partial field breach has little effect on huge object; no absolute invulnerability invented.

rows.en: So if we stay far away, we're picked off, and even if we close in, we can't do any real damage.
rows.notes: Quattro states range dilemma with restored allied we subject for both clauses.

rows.en: Then we'll have to destroy it from the inside.
rows.notes: Quattro concludes allies must destroy fortress internally.

rows.en: F-from the inside... Who's going to do that!?
rows.notes: Elle questions who can perform infiltration; stutter and whole question.

rows.en: ...Let's go, Rom Stol!
rows.notes: Domon calls full Rom Stol to act together.

rows.en: Yes, I understand!
rows.notes: Rom accepts Domon call immediately.

rows.en: Huh!?
rows.notes: Elle surprised by immediate departure.

rows.en: Bro! Where are you going!?
rows.notes: Sai Saici calls Domon Bro as familiar nonfamilial address, not literal biological sibling.

rows.en: Could my brother and Domon be...!?
rows.notes: Leina guesses intent of her brother Rom and accompanying Domon; original unfinished question retained.

rows.en: ...Hari, please scan the inside of Fortress Island.
rows.notes: Ruri asks Hari to scan Fortress Island interior; direction is request to operator.
uncertain: Fortress Island exact shortened licensed English wording remains unverified; source-literal established central term.

rows.en: What?!
Please hurry. We don't have much time.
rows.notes: Ruri tells Hari to hurry because time is limited, source causal connection retained.

rows.en: Heh heh heh... It seems others besides Getter have become so terrified of us that they've fled.
rows.notes: Burai misreads Rom and Domon departure as fearful flight; besides Getter retained.

rows.en: Don't be ridiculous! My brother would never do that!
rows.notes: Leina denies her brother Rom would flee; no implication Domon is her sibling.

rows.en: But face reality. With your strength, you cannot bring down this Hyakki Fortress Island.
rows.notes: Burai says allied strength cannot bring down explicit full Hyakki Fortress Island.
uncertain: Hyakki Fortress Island is established glossary label, with no independently verified exact licensed English name.

rows.en: Heh, is that so? You'd better not think your common sense applies to those two.
rows.notes: Jet warns Burai that Rom and Domon transcend enemy assumptions.

rows.en: Indeed. With a master of Tenku Chushin Ken and the King of Hearts of the School of the Undefeated of the East...
rows.notes: Kyral sets up sentence completed by Allenby fresh248; full martial school and King of Hearts title retained; no completion added.
uncertain: School of the Undefeated of the East is established unverified school-name wording in glossary.

rows.en: They'll definitely clear a path for us!
rows.notes: Allenby completes Kyral's preceding conditional sentence; they are Rom and Domon, clear path for allies.

rows.en: What did you say...?
rows.notes: Burai answers allies' assurance in disbelief.

rows.en: Dr. Saotome! Aren't Getter's emergency repairs finished yet!?
rows.notes: Ryoma asks Dr. Saotome about emergency repairs before Getter sorties again.

rows.en: Just a little longer...! Please wait just a little longer!
rows.notes: Saotome asks Ryoma and Benkei to wait; repair near-completion and repeated plea retained.

rows.en: As long as it can move, that's enough! Please let us sortie!
rows.notes: Ryoma accepts bare mobility as sufficient and asks permission for both pilots to sortie.

rows.en: But if we put Liger on autopilot, we can't use Shine Spark!
rows.notes: Benkei warns autopilot for source-short Liger precludes Shine Spark; no expansion to Getter Shine.

rows.en: We'll do it anyway! If we don't defeat Burai here, Japan will...!!
rows.notes: Ryoma insists despite lost technique; consequence for Japan deliberately unfinished.

rows.en: Wait, Ryo. I'll pilot Liger and sortie with you.
rows.notes: Saotome offers to take Liger himself; source nickname Ryo, no substitution of Ryoma.

rows.en: Y-you will, Doctor!?
rows.notes: Benkei's surprise explicitly asks whether Doctor himself will pilot.

rows.en: ...When we lost Musashi, I swore I'd never feel that way again...
rows.notes: Saotome recalls losing Musashi and his vow against experiencing that grief again.

rows.en: But once again, I've lost a son... I've lost Hayato...!
rows.notes: Source son followed by Hayato identification retained literally; no invented biological relation explanation.

rows.en: Doctor...
rows.notes: Ryoma trails off in response to the doctor on peaceful use of Getter Rays.

rows.en: I want to avenge him just as much as you do.
rows.notes: Saotome shares wish to avenge Hayato; him resolves from immediately preceding loss.

rows.en: And I won't send you alone into mortal danger. ...So please wait just a little longer.
rows.notes: Saotome will not let remaining pilots face deadly danger alone, then asks a little more patience.

rows.en: U-understood...!
rows.notes: Ryoma accepts Saotome request, stutter retained.

rows.en: The righteous do not always win... But the righteous must win.
rows.notes: Saotome contrasts non-guaranteed victory of righteous with moral necessity to win.

rows.en: Our chance to win will come. Until then, you must endure.
rows.notes: Saotome assures future chance of victory and tells pilots to endure until then.

rows.en: #部隊名, your valiant efforts thus far deserve praise...
rows.notes: Burai addresses runtime squad name; placeholder retained and maximum expansion measured.

rows.en: But you are not the only enemies we must fight. It's time I put an end to this.
rows.notes: Burai has other enemies besides allies; declares desire to finish current battle now.

rows.en: ! Is he coming!?
rows.notes: Kamille wonders whether Burai is about to act/come; he is Burai from preceding speech.

rows.en: Dr. Gura! Crush their carriers with Hyakki Fortress Island!
rows.notes: Burai orders Gura to crush allied carriers with source-full Hyakki Fortress Island.
uncertain: Hyakki Fortress Island exact licensed English wording remains unverified; established central glossary term.

rows.en: C-Captain! Fortress Island is heading straight for us!!
rows.notes: Hari alerts Ruri to approaching source-short Fortress Island.
uncertain: Fortress Island exact shortened licensed English wording remains unverified; source-literal established central term.

rows.en: Judging by the difference in mass... our field can't really stop it.
rows.notes: Ruri coolly explains mass disparity makes their protective field inadequate; no absolute physical claim added.

rows.en: N-no! Please don't talk like this has nothing to do with you!!
rows.notes: Hari objects to Ruri sounding uninvolved in their shared danger, not to a literal external party.

rows.en: Oh, we'll be fine. It seems the central section was found a moment ago.
rows.notes: Ruri reassures Hari and reports central section found; passive preserves withheld discoverer before next question.
uncertain: Discoverer left unidentified in this line; passive follows source omission and preserves reveal order.

rows.en: Huh!? F-found... by whom!?
rows.notes: Hari asks who found it; stutter on found retained, no prior reveal of Rom/Domon/Hayato identity.

rows.en: Target the enemy carriers! Begin the charge!!
rows.notes: Gura commands ram charge at enemy carriers.

rows.en: W-what!? What happened!?
rows.notes: Burai reacts to sabotage, before device report identifies cause.

rows.en: Th-the gravity control device is malfunctioning! Someone appears to have blown it up!!
rows.notes: Gura reports gravity control device trouble and apparent explosion by someone; no perpetrator identification yet.
uncertain: Gravity control device is source-literal established central term; exact licensed English wording unverified.

rows.en: Impossible! Who could have done such a thing!?
rows.notes: Burai demands culprit identity; impossible reaction retained.

rows.en: Heh heh heh... Ha ha ha ha ha!
rows.notes: Hidden speaker label remains ???; laughter before Rom reveal kept anonymous.
Burai surprise is punctuation-only deliberate interjection.

rows.en: You devils who deceive those who live by their faith in God, turning truth into lies...
rows.notes: Rom addresses devils who deceive people faithful to God and falsify truth; deliberate rhetorical fragment.

rows.en: Even if God never appears, one day those with a conscience will judge evil in God's place.
rows.notes: Rom promises conscientious people will eventually judge evil in God's stead even absent God.

rows.en: People call it divine punishment...!
rows.notes: Rom's People call it formula translated, divine punishment is ordinary description not new proper term.

rows.en: What do you want with Burai, Emperor of the Hyakki Empire!? Who are you!?
rows.notes: Burai states full imperial title and asks intruder purpose and identity, both questions retained.

rows.en: I have no name to give the likes of you!!
rows.notes: Rom refuses to introduce himself to villains; literal no-name formula maintained.

rows.en: Emperor Burai, it's them! What they did to Fortress Island...!!
rows.notes: Gura identifies intruders then leaves accusation about Fortress Island unfinished; what they did gives no specific destruction predicate.
uncertain: Fortress Island exact shortened licensed English wording remains unverified; source-literal established central term.
Specific action against Fortress Island left unfinished in source; accusation remains visibly unfinished in English.

rows.en: Them!?
rows.notes: Burai repeats demonstrative in surprise; no identities added.

rows.en: That's right...!
rows.notes: Domon confirms Gura accusation.

rows.en: We destroyed Fortress Island's gravity control device ourselves.
rows.notes: Hayato claims collective destruction of device; reveals survival only at source point.
uncertain: Gravity control device is source-literal established central term; exact licensed English wording unverified.

rows.en: Y-you...! Hayato Jin!! You're alive!?
rows.notes: Burai recognizes full Hayato Jin and asks whether he survived.

rows.en: Heh... That's right, you old demon chief.
rows.notes: Hayato taunts Burai with literal demon chief address; not new official title.

rows.en: H-Hayato...!!
rows.notes: Michiru emotional name call with stutter.

rows.en: H-he... He's not a ghost or anything, is he!?
rows.notes: Benkei wonders whether Hayato is a ghost; not a declarative supernatural claim.

rows.en: I'm the real thing, all right. I've even got both feet.
rows.notes: Hayato insists he is real and has feet; preserves Japanese footless-ghost joke, no added cultural explanation.

rows.en: B-but how did you end up there...!?
rows.notes: Michiru asks how Hayato came to be on fortress; source question restored with subject/verb.

rows.en: They blew such a huge hole in Liger... Leaping onto this Fortress Island was an all-or-nothing gamble.
rows.notes: Hayato says Liger's huge breach made leaping to Fortress Island an all-or-nothing gamble.
uncertain: Fortress Island exact shortened licensed English wording remains unverified; source-literal established central term.

rows.en: H-how reckless...!
rows.notes: Vega condemns Hayato dangerous improvisation; stutter retained.

rows.en: I don't think you're one to talk, Vega...
rows.notes: Misato says Vega cannot criticize another's recklessness; direct second-person teasing with source name.

rows.en: ...Then we met up inside the fortress and used Captain Hoshino's data to find and destroy the gravity control device.
rows.notes: Domon explains joining Hayato inside fortress and using Captain Hoshino data to locate and destroy device; no scan mechanics imported.
uncertain: Gravity control device is source-literal established central term; exact licensed English wording unverified.

rows.en: Th-this is unfolding like a manga.
rows.notes: Hikaru compares unfolding events to manga; stutter retained.

rows.en: There's a limit to how crazy you can get!
rows.notes: Asuka rebukes outrageous disregard for common sense, not a diagnosis of insanity.

rows.en: Well, all's well that ends well, right?
rows.notes: Light accepts successful outcome with all's-well idiom.

rows.en: Argh! Hyakki warriors, kill them at once!!
rows.notes: Burai orders Hyakki warriors to kill intruders immediately; lethal force preserved.

rows.en: I won't let you!!
rows.notes: Ryoma declares he will prevent executions; reused Mach Wing follows before next owned line.

rows.en: Mach Wiiing!!
rows.notes: Canonical Mach Wing confirmed by root at https://akurasu.net/wiki/Super_Robot_Wars/X-Omega/Abilities. Mach Wiiing!! preserves source elongated deployment shout.

rows.en: Hayato! Jump aboard Getter!!
rows.notes: Ryoma tells Hayato to leap aboard Getter; source-short unit name retained.

rows.en: Yeah!!
rows.notes: Hayato accepts Ryoma boarding instruction.

rows.en: Rom, we're going too!!
rows.notes: Domon tells Rom to leave fortress with him too.

rows.en: Yes! Now the real battle begins!!
rows.notes: Rom agrees and announces real battle begins now.

rows.en: Kenro, guide me! Piiile Formaaation!!
rows.notes: Rom calls established Kenro sword and Pile Formation; prolonged shout represented in English vowels.
uncertain: Pile Formation is established glossary transliteration without exact primary licensed English verification; elongated shout preserved.

rows.en: Come! Gundaaaaaam!!
rows.notes: Domon summons Gundam with prolonged shout; unit not expanded to God Gundam absent source.

rows.en: Curse you! Don't get carried away!!
rows.notes: Burai curses intruders for getting carried away; following Gura report starts alien reinforcement reveal.

rows.en: Emperor Burai, a group of objects is descending from above!
rows.notes: Gura alarms Burai about descending objects; no identity invented before Duke identifies forces.

rows.en: What!?
The Vegan Empire forces!
rows.notes: Vegan Empire forces canonical organization spelling.

rows.en: Zuril! What have you come for now, of all times!?
rows.notes: Burai challenges Zuril's late arrival in the battle; timing is situational, not a time of day.

rows.en: Such harsh words... I've brought you reinforcements.
rows.notes: Zuril presents reinforcements with outward courtesy; following retreat reveals abandonment.

rows.en: What...!?
S-space monsters!?
A-and three huge ones, at that...!!
Well, this really is one massive clash in the skies.
rows.notes: Source sky-clash wording rendered as spoken description; possible title allusion not expanded.

rows.en: Now then, Emperor Burai... I wish you and your forces luck in battle.
rows.notes: Wish directed to Burai and his forces; ironic courtesy before departure.

rows.en: You bastard, are you running away!?
We have our own circumstances to attend to...
Once the Hyakki Empire is victorious, I shall come to pay my respects again.
Wait, Zuril!
D-damn that Zuril...! Has he given up on us!?
rows.notes: Burai realizes Zuril has abandoned alliance; question preserves source reaction.

rows.en: How pathetic, Emperor Burai. Now that you've lost your castle and your allies, you're nothing but an emperor with no clothes.
rows.notes: Naked-emperor metaphor retained; castle and allies both lost after sabotage and Zuril departure.

rows.en: Admit defeat, Emperor Burai! Even with all those space monsters, you have no chance of winning!
E-Emperor Burai...
Enough! Don't panic! If it's come to this...!
Deploy the Combined Hyakki Robot! I shall sortie myself!
rows.notes: Combined Hyakki Robot canonical full unit name.

rows.en: What the hell is that!?
Behold my trump card... The mightiest Hyakki of all, the Combined Hyakki Robot!
rows.notes: Mightiest Hyakki claim and full Combined Hyakki Robot name both retained.

rows.en: Even if Fortress Island cannot move, I'll defeat you all with this machine!!
rows.notes: Fortress Island source-short literal label, capitalized; disabled movement does not preclude Burai sortie.
uncertain: Fortress Island is project source-short literal label; exact licensed English label unverified.

rows.en: Heh... It's convenient for us if you're coming out to fight.
Here we come, Emperor Burai! We'll defeat you and crush the Hyakki Empire's ambitions right here!!
Hayato!
Michiru... I'm sorry...
rows.notes: Postbattle apology to Michiru; reused i083a:0 greeting read before this row.

rows.en: I was so... so worried about you...!
I'm sorry... But I came back alive... To keep my promise to you, Michiru...
rows.notes: Promise to return alive refers to i083b:93; short final purpose clause intentionally preserved.

rows.en: It's all right... It's all right now... As long as you're safe...
rows.notes: Conditional final clause intentionally trails off.

rows.en: Thank you... Michiru...
Hayato... I've fixed the chain on your cross.
rows.notes: Cross chain repaired, not cross itself; callback to i083b:89..91.

rows.en: No... I want you to keep it, Michiru.
rows.notes: Hayato asks Michiru to keep cross; direction settled by her acceptance in next row.

rows.en: If that's what you want, Hayato, I'd be glad to...
rows.notes: Michiru agrees to keep cross; acceptance deliberately trails off.

rows.en: Well then, Captain Bright... We'll be returning to GEAR headquarters for now.
rows.notes: Vega addresses Captain Bright and announces temporary return to GEAR headquarters.

rows.en: Understood. But does it really exist...? This seventh Data Weapon...?
rows.notes: Bright questions existence of seventh Data Weapon; uncertainty preserved.

rows.en: According to my brother Altair, that seventh one seems to be Gulfer's true objective.
rows.notes: Altair explicitly Vega's brother; Gulfer true target is seventh Data Weapon, identity not revealed.

rows.en: At any rate, we'll examine the Gear Commander again with Meteo at GEAR headquarters.
rows.notes: Meteo is GEAR central computer, not the unrelated map-object Meteor; full main entry prevails.

rows.en: All right. We'll remain in the Far East and mop up the remaining Hyakki Empire forces.
rows.notes: Far East is geographic region here, not Far East Command organization.

rows.en: Heh heh... It's been a while since we were at HQ. I wonder if I'll have time to go home?
Ginga... We're not going back to headquarters to take a break.
Lucky you... Your mom's with you, so you can have stew whenever you want.
rows.notes: Ginga envies Hokuto because Vega, Hokuto's mother, accompanies him; stew retained.

rows.en: I-it's not like I'm always pestering Mom for it, either!
Who knows...? Maybe you even sleep with her at night...
rows.notes: Ginga teases Hokuto about sharing mother's bed; reused angry Ginga!! response at i083a:19 read.

rows.en: Ginga!!
That's enough, both of you. Save the rest for when we get back to headquarters.
Well then, Kirakuni... We're counting on you for the trips there and back.
rows.notes: Eris asks Kirakuni for transportation both ways; direction kept as requesting, not offering.

rows.en: Yeah, you got it.
Well then, we're off. Take care, Captain Bright.
Yes... Give my regards to Chief Shibuya, too.
rows.notes: Bright asks Vega to convey his regards to Chief Shibuya.

rows.en: Unbelievable...! This man has crossed the Heavenly Demon Castle's dimensional barrier...!
rows.notes: Ashura identifies intruder as man in source; Heavenly Demon Castle is canonical project literal translation.
uncertain: Heavenly Demon Castle is project literal translation; exact licensed English location label unverified.

rows.en: Who are you?
Heh heh heh...
rows.notes: Unknown speaker stays ??? until explicit Zero introduction in row367.

rows.en: D-don't tell me... Please spare us that "I have no name to give the likes of you!" routine!!
rows.notes: Devil Saturn 6 fears Rom's catchphrase; quoted wording matches Rom sense, informal panicked voice retained.

rows.en: Quiet, all of you.
...You are Lord Gades, leader of the Gyandlar, correct?
rows.notes: Unknown speaker addresses Gades formally; name remains hidden until row367.

rows.en: I commend you for making it this far...
Now, what is your purpose? Have you come for my head?
You must be joking...
rows.notes: Polite dismissal of Gades's assassination suspicion.

rows.en: My name is Zero... On the orders of my master, the Gulfer Emperor, I have come to Earth to cooperate with you.
rows.notes: Explicit self-identification switches speaker from ??? to Zero; master and cooperation purpose both retained.

rows.en: Gulfer's highest officer has come in person...?
Yes... But I am not the only one who has come to Earth from Gulfer's home planet...
rows.notes: Another arrival only; keep identity withheld.

rows.en: The most important mission I have been given is to protect that person...
rows.notes: Unknown escort referent deliberately person/gender-neutral; no later-reveal identity imported.

rows.en: What... Who is this person...?
rows.notes: Gades asks unknown escorted person identity.

rows.en: Heh heh heh... That would be...
rows.notes: Reveal deliberately withheld by scene-ending unfinished clause.

context_review.note: Coordinator read all 373 final fresh translations, all 33 fresh uncertainty rows with original neighbors, and every actual use of all 15 non-template reused rows (FULL IDs 9,36,238,239,257,323,366,375,378,394,412,457,490,509,515). Original command audit proves the remaining 143 reused defeat-template rows have 205 registrations and no ordinary uses. All six actual translators preserved full immutable initial drafts; every initial and final row fits the current font without compression. Reviewed all before/map/after scenes and event order, including conditional Burai-defeat storage and later unnamed escort. Final-only clone/groan wordplay, unfinished Fortress Island accusation, Dr. Gura normalization and situational now-of-all-times correction retain source meaning; no future identity, gender or completed omitted predicate added. Fortress Island, gravity control device, Ogre Island and Red Arrow Squadron retain bounded licensed-provenance flags; short Pikadron follows exact Akurasu evidence. Source omissions, proverb, calls and inherited uncertainties remain recorded.
